title: Wrong Answer Buzzer
blurb: No. Absolutely not. Thanks for playing. The game-show buzzer trained audiences over decades of television to feel it in the chest before the brain catches up: a harsh low buzz engineered to be unpleasant, because humiliation was always part of the format. Deploy it for quiz nights, for group chats, and for the exact moment someone says trust me before being catastrophically wrong. Play it out loud during an argument and the argument ends. There is no appeal process. Free MP3 for edits, streams and classroom revision games.
origin: Modeled on the classic Family Feud-style rejection buzzer.
